svg.title: Rescue Radar architecture
svg.desc: Offline: HumAID data is split by disaster, a LoRA adapter for NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super is trained on Fireworks serverless training, and every system is scored on unseen 2019 disasters. Online: posts flow through the FastAPI server to the same model on Fireworks serverless sampling; rescue-critical posts go to a priority queue after PII redaction and geocoding; a human dispatcher decides.

text.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'SF Pro Display', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Same prompt, same weights, same code path for the benchmark and the live console: what was scored is what the dispatcher sees.
